title: The Wizard's Rice with Chickpeas and Caramelised Onion
subtitle: served with yoghurt and herbs
description: Jasmine rice cooked with deeply browned onions and served with soft chickpeas, yoghurt and fresh herbs.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the chopped onions, stirring, for about 30 minutes until nicely browned.

Add the rice, stir and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, until the grains turn white. Add the salt and boiling water, stir, cover and cook over low heat for 18 minutes, until all the liquid is absorbed. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 10 more minutes.
Serve the rice with soft chickpeas, yoghurt and chopped coriander or parsley. For a vegan version, serve with tahini instead of yoghurt or leave it out.
